title: Great Expectations
author: Charles Dickens
summary: Pip, a poor blacksmith's apprentice in the Kent marshes, is told by a lawyer that a mysterious benefactor will make him a gentleman. He moves to London and must reckon with the cost of his ambition.
readIf: you like a classic with a strong plot, memorable characters and a sharp sense of social class.
skipIf: you find nineteenth-century prose slow going.

pairings.reason: Another Dickens novel about a young man making his way, longer and more comic.
A darker Dickens story of an orphan, crime and the cruelty of the poor-law system.
Another story of an unexpected fortune and a plan that goes beyond what its maker imagined.
